sources.title: Pokémon TCG Rules — Sword & Shield—Fusion Strike
sources.verification: The V-UNION appendix gives a deck-search example for a Psychic Pokémon and explains that printed type is a characteristic that may be referenced on an individual private-zone card piece.
sources.supportsZh: 用于“检索指定属性宝可梦”应读取审核印刷属性、并区分私有区域与场上特征的通用数据建模。

sources.title: Play! Pokémon Competitive Pokémon Rules and Formats
sources.verification: The official index provides maintained entry points for rulebooks, legality notices and errata.
sources.supportsZh: 用于后续逐卡、逐规则包核验；索引页不被解释为完整单卡裁定。

retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, translated card name, artwork, energy-cost symbol or community source is used to infer a Pokémon type.
Cards without audited pokemonTypes metadata never match a typed selection.
implementationLimits: Supports an ANY-of list of explicit Pokémon types for private-zone selection only.
The filter requires card_category POKEMON and cannot make a card playable without complete text, timing and legality review.
